cases.pattern: An agent records why it deferred some content to improve initial rendering; the task does not clearly exclude deferral.
directives: A reasoned trade-off or conflicting task wording and supplied inputs is decision_needed
check whether the task forbids deferred loading before asking to remove it

cases.pattern: Task wording and the supplied reference support different models; replacing the supplied one would discard an earlier passing comparison.
directives: For conflicting references, compare both reference models with the available validator.
Destructive flag: start message_to_main_agent with 'Destructive change:'

cases.pattern: Two plausible reference models produce different dimensions; the reviewer must preserve the alternative and let the agent decide.
directives: Give both interpretations with their evidence in discrepancy and alternative_interpretation
one cheap discriminating check in message_to_main_agent
you decide; record your choice and reason with respond acknowledged or rejected

cases.pattern: The task explicitly forbids deferral, and the agent defers content with a reason.
directives: Before task_requirement_unmet, locate the requirement in the task text and cite it.
A recorded reason does not excuse a clear violation of an unambiguous requirement

cases.pattern: A single slower run under a changed warm-up setup is called a regression.
directives: Before calling a performance change a regression, require repeated, comparable timings
A single noisy timing or a changed measurement setup does not establish a regression.
